profile.aboutHtml:
I'm Abdelrahman Eslam Omar, a first-year Data Science student at Alexandria University (Class of 2028) with a real passion for turning messy data into meaningful insights.

I've built ML pipelines that achieved 96% R2 on regression tasks, led a 10-member team project, and completed practical training in data analysis.

I'm currently focused on strengthening my machine learning foundations, learning deep learning, and building a portfolio that shows clear, practical problem-solving.

blogs.title: Getting Started with Machine Learning: A Practical Guide
blogs.summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the ML workflow, from data preprocessing to model evaluation.
blogs.content:
Machine learning projects become easier when you treat them as a workflow, not a magic trick.

Start by understanding the problem, inspecting the data, cleaning missing values, and creating features that actually describe the thing you want to predict.

After that, train a simple baseline model, measure it clearly, and improve one part at a time.
